title: Enemy reversal logic produces zero-direction freeze
explanation: At frame 726 an enemy_reversed_at_wall event occurs with old_direction=0.0 and new_direction=0.0 (enemy_reversed_at_wall). The next state_snapshot at frame 780 shows Enemy5 vel_x=0.0 and still at distance 80.0, confirming the enemy is frozen. A later snapshot at frame 840 shows the same frozen state, indicating the reversal did not change direction.
